allowSaveAndLoadConfiguration.description: Gives users the option to save and load filter searches.

allowAdvancedFilterMode.description:
Gives users the option to switch to an advanced filtering mode. In this mode the filter panel
switches to a command line form where a user can type detailed queries to create more complex
filter requests.
